description: This bar chart illustrates the performance gain for different large vision-language models (LVLMs) under varying levels of supervision. The horizontal axis represents the LVLM, with categories labeled “GPT-4o”, “Claude-3.5-Sonnet”, and “Qwen2-72B-VL”, presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Performance Gain (%)”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at 5-unit intervals. Two bars are present for each LVLM category, representing “Strong Supervision” in a dark purple color and “Weak Supervision” in a light purple color. For GPT-4o, the “Strong Supervision” bar extends to approximately 24% while the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 10%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the “Strong Supervision” bar extends to approximately 10% and the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 6%. Finally, for Qwen2-72B-VL, the “Strong Supervision” bar extends to approximately 16% and the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 8%. The bars are arranged in pairs, with the “Strong Supervision” bar consistently positioned to the left of the “Weak Supervision” bar for each LVLM. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
